name: Novel object recognition
description: After exploring two identical objects, the animal is tested with one familiar and one new object. Measures recognition memory: animals that remember the familiar object spend more time exploring the new one.

parameters.label: Arena width
parameters.help: Inside width of the arena floor, wall to wall, along the horizontal axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Arena depth
parameters.help: Inside depth of the arena floor, wall to wall, along the vertical axis of the camera image.

parameters.label: Exploration distance
parameters.help: Sniffing with the nose pointed at an object counts as exploration only within this distance from the object.

parameters.label: Minimum total exploration
parameters.help: Animals that explore both objects for less than this in total get no discrimination index. 0 disables the criterion.

inputEvents.label: Object exploration
inputEvents.definition: Nose directed at an object within object_zone_radius_cm; climbing or sitting on the object is not exploration.

metrics.label: Novel object exploration
metrics.description: Time spent exploring the new object.
metrics.definition: Length of the union of novel exploration intervals; overlaps count once.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when exploration was not scored.

metrics.label: Familiar object exploration
metrics.description: Time spent exploring the familiar object.
metrics.definition: Length of the union of familiar exploration intervals.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when exploration was not scored.

metrics.label: Total exploration
metrics.description: Time spent exploring either object; very low values make the discrimination index unreliable.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when exploration was not scored.

metrics.label: Discrimination index
metrics.description: Preference for the new object, from -1 to +1. Positive values indicate the familiar object is remembered; values near 0 indicate no preference.
metrics.missingWhen: Missing (NOT_SCORED) when not scored, (BELOW_EXPLORATION_CRITERION) when total exploration is below min_total_exploration_s, (ZERO_DENOMINATOR) when it is 0.
